versions.changelog:
community-group-buying-after-sales-service v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive after-sales and customer service package for community group-buying.
- Covers refund/return processing, complaint handling, customer service system design, platform policy comparison, and supporting tools.
- Includes detailed SOPs, industry benchmarks, and common issue templates for platform managers and group leader operators.
- Provides an after-sales refund calculator tool and operational guidelines for customer service teams.
